title: Terrain safety: slope per map and position, safe-and-lit
label: SOURCE-BASED · UNVALIDATED
description: Plane-fit slope from the PGDA 78 5 m DEM at 5, 25 and 100 m baselines, nominal and 20 clones.

dims.label: Terrain map: PGDA 78 nominal + 20 error clones
dims.note: k of N maps is not a probability; the clones are deterministic alternates (PGDA 78 error realizations).

max_slope_25m_deg.label: Max 25 m slope in 2 km region
max_slope_25m_deg.provenance: science/cube/slope.py plane fit on PGDA 78 5 m

eva_region.method: 25 m-baseline plane fit; square region 2000 m centred on the site; limit 20° (ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION)

dims.name: R_slope
dims.label: Landing slope limit over 100 m (ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION)

safe_all_20.label: Landing slope below limit on all 20 clone maps

k_lit.label: Clone maps passing the team visibility requirement (2026-11-14 window)

k_safe_and_lit.label: Safe on all 20 maps AND lit on k of 20 maps (0 if not safe)

nominal_lit.label: Nominal map passes the team visibility requirement

safe_and_lit.method: a cell passes only if the 100 m landing slope < limit on all 20 clone maps; its lit count is k of 20 clone maps passing Sun >= 70 %, Sun+Earth >= 40 %, Sun gap <= 120 h
safe_and_lit.caveat: k of N maps is not a probability; the clones are deterministic alternates (PGDA 78 error realizations).
